description.text: DMZ is a tech incubator and startup ecosystem at Toronto Metropolitan University helping founders build, launch, and scale. 2,600+ startups. $3.1B+ raised. 15+ countries.

targetApplicants.text: Unlike unicorns chasing rapid growth, camels conserve resources, navigate challenges, and play the long game. We help founders build lean, adaptable companies designed to last.
